title: Redundancy
hook: If your one payment processor froze your account tomorrow, sales would just stop. That's a risk, not a plan.
statement: Backup systems are what keep you alive when something breaks.
explainer: Single points of failure feel fine until the day they fail. One working backup for your riskiest dependency can be the difference between a bad day and a dead business.
sop: List the top 5 dependencies that would stop revenue if they broke.
For the riskiest one, name the Primary system and whether a Backup exists.
Build one working backup this week.
Test it for real. Actually switch over and see what happens.
Set a quarterly reminder to re-test every backup.
equation_example: Primary is 1 working main system. Backup is 1 ready to go. 1 + 1 = 2. Higher means more things can fail before you stop. A Resilience of 1 means one failure shuts the whole thing down.
question: Name the one thing in your business with no backup that would hurt most to lose.
closing_statement: An untested backup is a guess, not a safety net.
caption:
Principle Nº 126: Redundancy

If your one payment processor froze your account tomorrow, sales would just stop. That's a risk, not a plan.

Backup systems are what keep you alive when something breaks.

Your turn: Name the one thing in your business with no backup that would hurt most to lose.
